Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 20
, Reason for Mistake: When the Bing results (step 16) showed the authoritative “Fubo - Governance - Management Team” link, WebSurfer ignored it and instead clicked an unrelated LinkedIn profile (“Jonathan Luftman,” step 20). This diverted the search away from Fubo’s official management bios (which typically list join years and would have revealed Gina DiGioia joined in 2020), causing wasted time and ultimately the failure to produce the correct answer.
